message:
Command `cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7068,"var":"ctxt","code":"xmlParseReference(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt)","note":"The parser reaches an attacker-controlled entity reference in document content."},
  {"step":2,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7398,"var":"cur","code":"cur = ent->children; ent->children = NULL;","note":"The cached entity subtree is detached from the entity before any copying occurs."},
  {"step":3,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7400,"var":"last","code":"last = ent->last; ent->last = NULL;","note":"The entity's tail pointer is cleared, leaving the detached subtree only reachable through local iteration state."},
  {"step":4,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7405,"var":"cur->parent","code":"cur->parent = NULL;","note":"Each detached node is unlinked from its original parent, so later namespace lookups must rely on stale source-tree metadata."},
  {"step":5,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7373,"var":"nw","code":"nw = xmlDocCopyNode(cur, ctxt->myDoc, 1);","note":"The detached node is copied into the parser document, invoking the namespace reconciliation path in tree.c."},
  {"step":6,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7435,"var":"xmlAddChild","code":"if (xmlAddChild(ctxt->node, cur) == NULL) xmlErrMemory(ctxt);","note":"The original detached node is inserted into the document tree, preserving stale namespace pointers from the entity cache."},
  {"step":7,"file":"tree.c","function":"xmlDocCopyNode","line":4459,"var":"extended","code":"xmlDocCopyNode(xmlNodePtr node, xmlDocPtr doc, int extended)","note":"The detached node is duplicated into the target document through the generic copy helper."},
  {"step":8,"file":"tree.c","function":"xmlStaticCopyNode","line":4282,"var":"node->ns","code":"ns = xmlSearchNs(node->doc, node, node->ns->prefix);","note":"During the copy, namespace resolution dereferences the source node's namespace prefix and can touch freed or stale namespace state after detachment and reinsertion."}
]
EOF
